title: Find the names of all black-bordered cards with full artwork that belong to
question: Find the names of all black-bordered cards with full artwork that belong to sets released on or after January 1, 2007, are available on Magic: The Gathering Online, and have at least one Russian translation.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c.XCL_049
FROM cards AS c
JOIN sets AS s ON c.XCL_063 = s.XCL_099
JOIN set_translations AS st ON c.XCL_063 = st.XCL_093
WHERE c.XCL_005 = 'black'
  AND c.XCL_018 = 'extendedart'
  AND c.XCL_004 LIKE '%mtgo%'
  AND s.XCL_112 >= '2007-01-01'
  AND st.XCL_092 = 'Russian'
